entities.summary: Noora Tulus is a Finnish ice hockey forward for Bryäs IF of the Swedish Women's Hockey League (SDHL) and member of the Finnish national team. She previously played for Luleå HF of the SDHL and the New York Sirens of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL).
